column2: in a deep play bow stretch: both front legs stretched far forward flat along the ground, chest and chin pressed down low touching the ground, bottom and back legs raised high up in the air, tail up, strict side profile facing right, head on the right

sniffing the ground: standing on all four legs with her head lowered all the way down so her nose touches the ground in front of her front paws, ears hanging down, strict side profile facing right, head on the right

sitting on her haunches and scratching behind her ear with one back leg lifted high up to her ear, head tilted towards the raised leg, eyes squinting happily, side profile facing right, head on the right
falling through the air: all four legs splayed out wide, ears and fur blown straight upwards, eyes wide and surprised, mouth open, body horizontal, side profile facing right, head on the right
